inventory.notes: Initial inventory covers extension runtime, configuration, operational scripts and test infrastructure. Descriptions were reviewed against current owning paths and existing evidence; no fresh real-NAS run, Firefox runtime parity or universal feature discovery is implied. Source-file coverage is independent of the feature denominator. Confirmed cleanup candidates and scope differences are recorded in docs/system/feature-review.md.

features.title: QNAP transport, login, sessions and API errors
features.notes: Typed client, SID middleware, login encoding/replay, task methods and schema were compared with current sources; hardware interoperability is not inferred.

review.reason: Reviewed required multipart move serialization, empty-target body regression, vendor-verified destination-space wording and the reused confirmed-duplicate marker; API README retains NAS value validation and unknown/reason fallback. Final type-only review uses partial numeric catalogs to represent unknown codes accurately; runtime lookup and fallback behavior are unchanged.

features.title: Connection form and persistent settings
features.notes: Storage precedence, local credential persistence, schema migration, configured-vs-health state and five-second login check were inspected.

review.reason: User-requested direct import: choosing a valid backup immediately fills the connection draft and reveals its fields; native Save/Enter remains the only persistence action. Reviewed malformed-file preservation and unchanged-storage browser assertions against canonical settings documentation.

features.title: Optional Settings-screen password
features.notes: PBKDF2 verifier, session unlock and Settings-only mounting were inspected; no encrypted-credential guarantee is claimed.

review.reason: Shared Settings review after removing import confirmation: only non-secret draft loading changed. Lock enable/disable, password confirmation, storage and native submit validation remain unchanged; security prose stays accurate.

features.title: Non-secret settings export and import
features.notes: Portable keys, parser boundaries, password exclusion and confirmation path were compared with code and existing tests.

review.reason: Final direct-import source review: removed pending confirmation and its unused description helper with clean EOFs; parser completes before draft mutation, passwords remain excluded, and Save/Enter owns persistence. Browser assertions cover invalid JSON, immediate fields and storage boundaries.

features.title: First-match routing and rule editor
features.notes: Classification, release-name routing, domains, list/glob matching and editor behavior were inspected; batch routing difference is explicit.

review.reason: Shared Settings review after direct-import simplification: valid imported rules still become drafts through the existing parser; validation, matching, reorder and Save serialization are unchanged. Removed confirmation does not persist rules before Save; routing documentation remains accurate.

features.title: NAS folder selection and validation
features.notes: Relative paths, parent listing, writability and invalid-vs-unverifiable outcomes were inspected; permissions can change after validation.

review.reason: Reviewed changed settings-connection evidence: backup round-trip now imports directly and saves with Enter; folder-picker keyboard boundary remains asserted unchanged. FolderSelect implementation and canonical keyboard/path semantics remain those accepted in BUG-81.

features.title: Transactional browser torrent hand-off
features.notes: Event claims, deferred filename, live login, tracker fetch, cancel-after-accept and browser fallback were inspected; BUG-70 remains unproven.

review.reason: BUG-80: traced real Chromium invalid downloadId after erase, observed red native-download E2E, then independently passed the unchanged regression three times. Reviewed callback discard after successful cancel and retained browser fallback on rejection against source, 40 handoff unit tests, and canonical lifetime documentation; mock NAS evidence only.

features.title: Page magnet and scoped ordinary-file sends
features.notes: Eligible click gates, download attributes/path allow-list, Shift override, worker messages, cleanup/reinjection and navigation fallback were inspected.

review.reviewer: Codex acceptance after Terra and Mimic review
review.reason: Reviewed pending-map ownership, late/dismissed replies, unknown acceptance, duplicate metadata, preserved native anchor attributes and genuine retained-tab reload; page-capture canonical contract now matches the controlled callback and browser evidence.

features.title: Explicit context-menu link sends
features.notes: Menu reinitialization, URL support, shared classification/routing, monitoring and direct failure notifications were inspected.

review.reviewer: Codex acceptance after Terra and Mimic review
review.reason: Reviewed accepted duplicate outcomes and shared page result metadata; actual failures propagate while success stays quiet and task-list/toolbar confirmation remains explicit.

features.title: Local torrent and batch URL submission
features.notes: Current success/duplicate/error messages, release-name routing for local files and the 50-line independent URL outcomes were inspected.

review.reason: Only tests/e2e/feedback-normalization.spec.ts changed: the 'poll failures cannot replace settings or upload feedback' scenario now waits for the initial refresh and advances the paused clock until the first 2s poll fires, removing a CI race (failed in runs 38068161110 and 38615736670). Assertions, product source and canonical-page behavior are unchanged; 20/20 repeats and the full spec passed locally.

features.title: Live task list, filtering and task details
features.notes: Current-query rendering, live shared selection, abort/controller identity, connection generation and removal reconciliation were inspected; the unread parallel snapshot is removed.

review.reason: Only tests/e2e/feedback-normalization.spec.ts changed: the 'poll failures cannot replace settings or upload feedback' scenario now waits for the initial refresh and advances the paused clock until the first 2s poll fires, removing a CI race (failed in runs 38068161110 and 38615736670). Assertions, product source and canonical-page behavior are unchanged; 20/20 repeats and the full spec passed locally.

features.title: Task actions, queue order and torrent file priority
features.notes: Start/pause/stop/remove, clean-delete confirmation, SetTaskPriority and GetFile/SetFile call paths were inspected.

review.reason: Only tests/e2e/feedback-normalization.spec.ts changed: the 'poll failures cannot replace settings or upload feedback' scenario now waits for the initial refresh and advances the paused clock until the first 2s poll fires, removing a CI race (failed in runs 38068161110 and 38615736670). Assertions, product source and canonical-page behavior are unchanged; 20/20 repeats and the full spec passed locally.

features.title: Alarm polling, badge and attention state
features.notes: 30-second alarms, single badge writer, session state, authoritative zero handling and stopping on polling failure were inspected; full Task/Query is still used.

review.reviewer: Codex acceptance after Terra and Mimic review
review.reason: Reviewed gray/red attention preservation, gray acknowledgement without a false NAS failure, write retry and independent activity icon; serialized current-connection polling/alarm ownership remains intact.

features.title: Page, popup and system feedback
features.notes: Direct/poll ownership, scoped recovery, episode dismissal, timer receipt guards and accepted-outcome isolation are verified for targeted popup regressions; wider native/page policy remains open.

review.reason: BUG-80 shared-source review: only successful-cancel filename callback lifetime changed. Error collection is asserted in native Chromium rather than suppressed. Notification classification, accepted-handoff isolation, NAS-first cancellation and fallback branches retain their existing behavior; canonical feedback prose remains accurate.

features.title: Svelte popup composition and UI primitives
features.notes: Entrypoint mounting, native themed dismissal, panel invalidation and active primitives were inspected; unused Card is removed.

review.reason: Reviewed updated accessibility scenario: valid file selection directly reveals editable connection fields, invalid JSON preserves the draft, and storage/reopen remain unchanged without Save. Existing field border, focus, theme tokens and accessibility behavior remain intact.

features.title: Saved Auto, Light and Dark preference
features.notes: Theme application, immediate saving, OS listener replacement and page-toast theme behavior were inspected.

review.reason: Shared Settings review after direct-import simplification: choosing a backup still loads its theme into the draft while explicit theme activation retains immediate persistence. Removing confirmation adds no theme side effect; theme documentation remains accurate.

features.title: Browser builds, quality gates and release ownership
features.notes: Manifests, build targets, CI/deploy scripts, direct Store API uploader and Rulesync generation were compared; no new deployment or Firefox runtime claim.

review.reason: Reviewed synchronized 2.6.3 package, lockfile and Chrome/Firefox manifest versions against the unchanged env/dev-to-env/prod release workflow. No packaging or publication semantics changed; canonical build/release description remains accurate.

features.title: Storybook, store assets, demo and manual stand
features.notes: Harness entrypoints and consumers were inventoried; compilation/capture quality is not inferred, and undeclared manual-stand tsx remains open.

review.reason: Compared the current screenshot compositor and light/dark captures with the real popup. Reviewed the native 1080p support recording, visible captions, scene-aligned Emma narration, routing and file-link flow. The interface page already describes capture tooling and its mock-NAS limits; operational details are maintained in store-assets/README.md.

features.title: Mocks, fixture servers and real-NAS ownership
features.notes: Vitest projects, Chrome/MSW mocks, test stand and spotcheck ownership/redaction were inspected; no fresh hardware run is claimed.

review.reason: Reviewed the demo host ZIP attachment, opt-in writable dev folder, unchanged default mock behavior, narration cache and media-clock audio assembly. The native scenario asserts persisted rule/interception settings, torrent move=dev, ZIP move=Download, two returned tasks, badge and advancing progress. Both extended recordings passed, 64 mock E2E passed; the verification page explicitly distinguishes this fixture evidence from real NAS transfers.

features.title: Feature registry, reviews, language and drift guards
features.notes: Checker, explicit review command, English guard, staged inspection and source-discovery boundaries were inspected and exercised by self-tests.

review.reason: Reviewed unchanged one-feature review and actual-staged snapshot workflow against registry/report updates; new review reasons describe inspected evidence rather than automatic hash acceptance.
